data.one_liner: A swiper and carousel widget for Flutter supporting multiple layouts and infinite loops.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable Swiper widget that supports vertical and horizontal scrolling, continuous loops, autoplay, pagination dots, control buttons, and multiple built-in card layouts such as stack and tinder.
use_when: You need a carousel or swiper widget for images, cards, or onboarding screens.
You require custom card layouts like stack, tinder, or custom animations.
avoid_when: You only need a standard single-child scrollable or simple ListView.
strengths: Supports multiple built-in layouts (STACK, TINDER, CUSTOM, DEFAULT).
Includes customizable pagination dots, fractions, and control buttons.
weaknesses: PageTransformer currently only supports the default layout.
data.setup_notes: Add card_swiper to pubspec.yaml and import card_swiper.dart.

alternatives.name: carousel_slider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative feature-rich carousel slider widget for Flutter.
